newsitem.title: CHINA: China to join accounting standards group next year.
newsitem.headline: China to join accounting standards group next year.

text.p: China expects its certified public accountants to gain membership in the International Federation of Accountants (IFA) next year, the China Daily said on Wednesday.

The Chinese Institute of Certified Public Accountants (CICPA) had applied to join the federation, which sets international auditing standards, and expected to be approved at the IFA's council meeting next May, the newspaper quoted CICPA general secretary Ding Pinzhun as saying.

China, whose accounting standards have long lagged behind international practice, expected to join the International Accounting Standards Committee (IASC) next year, the newspaper said but gave no further details.
